text:
Maya: :rotating_light: Pager bridge missed a fanout to SMS + PagerDuty for a customer-facing alert, flagging now. No automatic pages landed for the oncall team.
Sam: On it, checking the bridge logs. Can someone confirm affected customer?
Maya: customer: acme-corp, alert: high-inflight-queue on ingest-prod, started ~1717654300.
IncidentBot: Alert routed to channel (ingest-prod) at 1717654305, delivery attempts: PD(0), SMS(0), Slack(1).
Lee: PD webhook returned 202 to the bridge but the bridge log shows "fanout_skipped: route_unavailable" for PD and SMS. Need to see webhook payload and headers.
Sam: grabbing recent bridge logs: ```
2024-05-04T12:45:07Z bridge INFO incoming=alert-9876 route=primary fanout=attempt
2024-05-04T12:45:07Z bridge WARN fanout_skipped route=PagerDuty reason=integration_disabled
2024-05-04T12:45:07Z bridge WARN fanout_skipped route=SMS reason=quota_exceeded
```
Jordan (oncall): I didn't get a page. I saw the Slack thread but no PD page. Manual paging now.
Maya: manual page sent to oncall, pinged Eng SRE rotation.
Sam: Checking config - looks like a recent deploy toggled a feature-flag that disables PD fanout when rate-limits hit. The quota_exceeded tag is odd (we haven't hit SMS quota). Reproducing with dry-run: ```
curl -X POST https://bridge.internal/push -H "X-Sig: abc" -d '{"alert":"test"}' -v
```
Lee: Also seeing a duplicate ack race when PD retries come back: bridge recorded duplicate_ack for acks that arrived after the route decision. Could cause it to mark route as stale.
IncidentBot: Noting incident severity P2. No customer-reported outage yet but pages missed.
Sam: Quick mitigation: re-enable PD fanout in bridge config and clear SMS quota flag, then re-run pending fanouts. Pushing change to canary now.
Maya: :thumbsup: if canary looks good, roll to primary.
OpsBot: Canary deploy completed on vm-pool-3, health=ok, fanout attempts resumed.
Jordan (oncall): Received PD page now, acknowledging.
Lee: Running a short sanity sweep for 10m. Also saving the problematic payloads to debug bucket s3://redwood-debug/pager-bridge/1717654322/
Sam: Postmortem items: 1) make fanout-disabled reasons more granular, 2) avoid marking routes disabled on transient duplicate ack, 3) add alerting for "fanout_skipped > 0".
Maya: Agreed. I'll create the incident ticket and link logs + remediation steps.
Jordan (oncall): Thanks — customer impact minimal (no reported customer pages), but this could have escalated. Recommend retro and quick patch.
Maya: Filing PV/INC and scheduling a 30m follow-up. :calendar: 
Sam: Leaving a short command snippet here for ops to requeue pending fanouts if needed: ```
python tools/bridge_requeue.py --path s3://redwood-debug/pager-bridge/1717654322/ --dry-run
```
Maya: Closing initial thread, follow-up to be in #postmortems when ready. :white_check_mark:
